scope: SDevice-only shared-node Si/SiO2 region-local signed AverageBox assembly diagnostic
claim_policy: The diagnostic retains one shared electrostatic degree of freedom at each material-interface node.
The signed node measure is summed only over transport-material cells and is disabled by default.
The M34 MeasureCoefficients.debug export is the direct geometry oracle.
A terminal-current improvement measures one coherent geometry response; it does not prove equivalence to all Sentaurus interface equations.
